subject: Headless verifier started after hand-in copies the ticket branch head; apply.sh records every OBJECTION line of worker and verifier EVIDENCE
objective: Written against the shape #155 lands (no --prepare, verifier_copy inlined into start_verifier_bg). (1) start_verifier_bg picks the copy source the way #149's --prepare verifier did: interface_fixed true -> ticket base_sha (unchanged, parallel with the worker); otherwise, branch t<n> with >= 1 commit over base_sha -> archive of the branch head, and the verifier dispatch packet gets a 'copy source' paragraph naming the branch and head sha and saying verify-case.py red --ref stays the ticket base_sha; otherwise (0 commits) the verifier is not started and stderr says so. archive_copy stays called exactly once, inside start_verifier_bg. (2) apply.sh feeds every ^OBJECTION: line of the --evidence file AND of each --evidence-verifier file to ticket.py objection (with that file as --evidence), not only grep -m1 of --evidence; any line that comes back fresh (rc 0) or undisposed (rc 3) makes apply exit 6 after all lines are recorded; ticket.py objection rc 2 on any line keeps today's rc-2 path. ticket.py record_objection (category + body match) is unchanged.
acceptance: B1 (auto-fix integration, tests/test_auto_fix.py stub worker/verifier like TheFirstRoundVerifierRunsAlongside): ticket needs_verifier true, interface_fixed absent; stub worker commits a new file w.txt='worker' on t1 -> when the verifier stub runs, <WTBASE>/verify-t1/round1/base/w.txt and work/w.txt exist with 'worker'; the verifier dispatch packet contains the branch name t1 and the branch head sha (sha read with git rev-parse in the test).
B2 same but interface_fixed true -> verifier copy base/ has no w.txt (base_sha content), packet has no copy-source paragraph.

B3 #155 failure reproduced end to end: worker commit changes line 2 of an existing tests/test_x.py; stub verifier edits line 3 of that same file in work/ and hands in patch-verify.diff -> apply.sh receipt rc 0 (not 3) and the branch head has a second commit containing the verifier's line; before this ticket the same fixture gives apply rc 3.

B4 interface_fixed absent and branch t1 has 0 commits over base_sha when start_verifier_bg is reached -> no verify-t1/round1 directory, stderr names #1 and says the verifier waits for worker commits; no agent.start role=verifier event.

B5 #155's verifier pin tests.test_auto_fix.T155TheInSessionPathIsGone.test_t6_the_shared_helpers_are_merged_back stays green unchanged: archive_copy has exactly one call site and it is inside start_verifier_bg.

C1 (tests/test_apply.py, ApplyBase): worker EVIDENCE with no OBJECTION + --evidence-verifier EVIDENCE with 'OBJECTION: blocking X cannot be measured' -> ticket objections[] gains one row category blocking, body 'X cannot be measured', evidence = relative path of the verifier EVIDENCE, owner main; apply rc 6; status file rc 6.
C2 the #155 scenario: ticket already has one disposed row (ticket-wrong, other body) -> the verifier blocking line of C1 is still recorded (objections length 1 -> 2), rc 6.
C3 one EVIDENCE with two different OBJECTION lines (ticket-wrong A, blocking B) -> both rows recorded in file order, rc 6.

C4 all lines already on the ticket and disposed -> nothing new recorded, apply continues to rc 0; existing cases test_the_same_objection_is_not_recorded_twice and test_an_objection_already_disposed_lets_the_second_apply_through stay green unchanged (oracle: tests/test_apply.py on t155, checked).
